text: 843 passes the scanned envelope fields into the output stream before writing each retained message. The accepted MboxCompactor still does so after its retention query and per-message reset. This keeps a known timestamp available for a later repair, rather than regenerating the separator with the current time. Unknown zero time is subject to the writer default, so it is not preserved as a literal zero.
title: Preserve envelope metadata while compacting retained messages
